scenarios.title: Reference Number Offered First
scenarios.description: User says they have a reference number, then supplies it when asked.
expected: Greeting should still ask for phone number and should not proactively mention reference number.
After the user says they have a reference number, the agent should ask for it.
Lookup should use reference_number=70360256 and resolve KELSEY HOWE.
Call should leave s1 and land in s2a_verify_name.
scenarios.first_message: Hi. Thanks for calling American Express. I'm your AI assistant here to help you. This call may be recorded, monitored, and analyzed for compliance and to improve our systems. I'm having trouble pulling up your information using the number that you're calling from. May I please have the phone number that you have on file with us?

checks.name: Greeting stays on phone lookup
checks.expected: Greeting should ask for phone number and not proactively mention reference number.
checks.actual: Hi. Thanks for calling American Express. I'm your AI assistant here to help you. This call may be recorded, monitored, and analyzed for compliance and to improve our systems. I'm having trouble pulling up your information using the number that you're calling from. May I please have the phone number that you have on file with us?

checks.name: Reactive offer is accepted
checks.expected: After the user says they have a reference number, the agent should ask for it.
checks.actual: Thank you for letting me know. I can look you up using that reference number. What's the reference number you have?

checks.name: Lookup uses reference_number parameter
checks.expected: The successful lookup should call get_details_from_contact with reference_number=70360256.

checks.name: Lookup exits s1 into name verification
checks.expected: After successful lookup, the call should move into s2a_verify_name.

checks.name: Post-lookup prompt is name verification
checks.expected: The next assistant prompt should ask for the consumer's full name.
checks.actual: Could you please help me with your full name?

scenarios.title: Bad Phone Then Reference Number
scenarios.description: User gives a wrong phone number, confirms it, gets the SSN offer, then switches to a reference number.
expected: Greeting should stay on phone-number collection.
Wrong phone number should be looked up as phone, then echoed for confirmation.
After confirmation, the agent should offer SSN without proactively mentioning reference number.
When the user then volunteers a reference number, the agent should accept it and resolve KELSEY HOWE.

checks.expected: After an empty phone lookup, the agent should echo the number back and ask if it was correct.
